$comment: Every environment variable this product's deployed surfaces read, stated once.
Before this file the answer to 'what must production have set' lived in four
places that drifted apart: a prose table in docs/PRODUCTION.md, a hand-typed
and the actual values in an untracked .env.production nobody could diff. A
variable added to the code entered none of them automatically, so the first
Two gates read this file and nothing else:
scripts/verify-env-registry.mjs     - the code and this registry agree (offline)
scripts/verify-production-config.mjs - the live project has what this says (online)
Values never live here. Only names, shapes and where a value is supposed to
come from. A secret's presence is checked; its content is never read.

web.description: Build-time values baked into the browser bundle by Vite.
web.note: Cloudflare uses Direct Upload, so dashboard variables cannot change a bundle after it is built. Whatever is missing at build time is missing in production until the next build.

functions.description: Supabase Edge Function secrets, read at request time.
functions.note: A missing secret is not a build failure. The function boots and answers 503 to real users, which is why these are checked against the live project before a release rather than trusted.

agent.description: Deployment configuration packaged into the desktop app.
agent.note: Tracked on purpose: none of these are secret, and packaging must not depend on a file only one machine has.

variables.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
variables.note: Absent means the app cannot reach its database at all: validatePublicConfig refuses to start.

variables.name: VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.note: Public by design, but must never be a secret or service_role key. Both this gate and the browser check that.

variables.name: VITE_SITE_URL
variables.note: Must equal the binding origin. A mismatch breaks the OAuth return trip, which looks like 'login does nothing'.

variables.name: VITE_AGENT_URL
variables.note: Optional: apps/web/src/lib/config.ts falls back to the loopback default. Set in production anyway so the value is explicit.

variables.name: VITE_APP_ENVIRONMENT
variables.note: Absent means production, deliberately: a build that forgets it gets the stricter rules instead of behaving like beta.

variables.name: VITE_GOOGLE_PICKER_API_KEY
variables.note: Without it the storage chooser never opens, and the failure is silent until an owner clicks Connect.

variables.name: VITE_GOOGLE_PROJECT_NUMBER
variables.note: Same chooser; the Picker refuses to initialise without the project number.

variables.name: VITE_TEAM_DIRECT_ADD_MODE
variables.note: Any other value is refused by both the browser and the build gate.

variables.name: VITE_TEAM_SELECTION_MODE
variables.note: Multi-selection opt-in for the storage list.

variables.name: VITE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED
variables.note: Beta additionally suppresses analytics in code, so this is a declaration of intent rather than the only barrier.

variables.name: VITE_LOCAL_DEV_AUTH
variables.note: A true value substitutes a hardcoded user. Refused outright in beta; it must never be set in production.

variables.name: VITE_ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.note: A development hint only. Admin rights come from the database, never from this value.

variables.name: VITE_PRODUCT_OPERATOR
variables.note: Shown in the legal pages. Empty leaves the operator unnamed, which the published Privacy Policy assumes is filled in.

variables.name: VITE_LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL
variables.note: Same pages, same caveat: the texts promise a contact address.

variables.name: VITE_WEB_BUILD_ID
variables.note: Build metadata for analytics. Falls back to the product version.

variables.name: VITE_WEB_REVISION
variables.note: Build metadata: which commit produced this bundle.

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.note: Injected by Supabase into every function. Never set by hand; listing it as required would fail a correct project.

variables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.note: Injected by Supabase.

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.note: Injected by Supabase.

variables.name: AGENT_TOKEN_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.note: Signs desktop entitlement tokens. Absent, issue-agent-token answers 503 and NOBODY can pair the desktop app — a total outage of the product's main flow that no build gate would have noticed.

variables.name: WISHLY_SITE_URL
variables.note: The origin functions accept requests from and build links against. Must match the web VITE_SITE_URL and the binding.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
variables.note: Drive OAuth. Absent, storage connection fails at the first redirect.

variables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.note: Drive OAuth token exchange.

variables.name: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
variables.note: Must match the Google console entry exactly, character for character, or the return trip fails after the user has already consented.

variables.name: DRIVE_OAUTH_MODE
variables.note: Production storage is legal only as 'verified'. 'testing' is refused on a production origin by the gate in _shared/auth.ts.

variables.name: DRIVE_RESTRICTED_SCOPE_APPROVED
variables.note: Only meaningful once a restricted scope is requested; unset means not approved.

variables.name: RESEND_API_KEY
variables.note: Invitation delivery. Absent, team-invitations returns the link instead of sending it — which is correct in beta and silently broken in production.

variables.name: INVITE_EMAIL_FROM
variables.note: The verified sender address invitations come from.

variables.name: CATALOG_SYNC_SECRET
variables.note: Shared secret the catalog worker authenticates with. Absent, Drive scanning never runs and libraries stay empty with no error shown.

variables.name: CATALOG_SYNC_BUDGET_MS
variables.note: Per-invocation time budget; the code has a default.

variables.name: PREVIEW_WARM_SECRET
variables.note: Same shape as the catalog worker: absent, preview warming rejects every request and previews never appear.

variables.name: TEAM_DIRECT_ADD_MODE
variables.note: Server half of the member pilot switch; the browser half is VITE_TEAM_DIRECT_ADD_MODE.

variables.name: SOTY_ENVIRONMENT
variables.note: Absent means production, matching the web surface.

variables.name: PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN
variables.note: The origin the packaged agent accepts browser requests from. Checked against the release binding before a deploy.

variables.name: DEV_SITE_ORIGIN
variables.note: Loopback origin for local development builds.

variables.name: AGENT_PORT
variables.note: Must differ from the beta agent port, or a beta build and a production build fight over the same socket.

variables.name: AGENT_ENTITLEMENT_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.note: Public half of the pair whose private half is the AGENT_TOKEN_PRIVATE_KEY function secret. If these two stop being a pair, every entitlement token verifies as invalid and paired users are logged out.

variables.name: DRIVE_OAUTH_MODE
variables.note: Read by the web-env gate to decide which deploy command is legal. Must agree with the function secret of the same name.
